steps.title: Analyze Current Calculator for History Integration
steps.description: Reviewed `MainActivity.java` and `activity_main.xml` to identify optimal points for integrating the calculation history feature without disrupting existing functionality.

steps.title: Modify Main Activity Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Adjusted the `GridLayout` in `activity_main.xml` to include a new 'History' button alongside the 'Clear' button, adapting their `layout_columnWeight` and `layout_columnSpan` properties.

steps.title: Implement History List in MainActivity
steps.description: Added a `private List<String> historyList` to `MainActivity.java` to store calculation entries.

steps.title: Add History Logging to Equals Click Logic
steps.description: Modified the `onEqualsClick()` method in `MainActivity.java` to capture the calculation expression and result, then add it to `historyList`.

steps.title: Create History Activity Layout (activity_history.xml)
steps.description: Designed a new XML layout file `activity_history.xml` containing a `ListView` to display the chronological list of past calculations.

steps.title: Develop History Activity (HistoryActivity.java)
steps.description: Created `HistoryActivity.java` to receive history data via an `Intent` and populate the `ListView` with an `ArrayAdapter`.

steps.title: Integrate History Button Click Handler
steps.description: Implemented an `OnClickListener` for the new 'History' button in `MainActivity.java` to launch `HistoryActivity` and pass the `historyList`.

steps.title: Declare History Activity in AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Added the `<activity>` tag for `HistoryActivity` to `AndroidManifest.xml` to ensure it is recognized by the Android system.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Verified that all new and modified Java code adheres to Java 8 compatibility standards, using traditional anonymous inner classes where necessary.

steps.title: Refine History Display Formatting
steps.description: Adjusted the formatting of history entries to ensure clear and readable presentation within the `HistoryActivity`'s `ListView`.

steps.title: Perform Full App Functionality Test
steps.description: Conducted a thorough test of the calculator's core functions and the new history feature to ensure stability and correctness.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link, and package the application artifacts with the new history feature.
